# Patwa Manufacturer

> Direct manufacturer of luxury passementerie — custom tassels, fringes, braids, cords, and decorative trims handcrafted in India and exported worldwide since 1990.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Patwa Manufacturer's luxury passementerie offering.
- [About](/about): 30+ year heritage, artisans, and manufacturing facility.
- [Passementerie Manufacturer](/passementerie-manufacturer): Manufacturing capabilities and services.
- [Custom Services](/custom-services): Bespoke design and custom manufacturing.
- [Product Configurator](/configurator): Interactive tool to design custom tassels and trims.
- [Trade Program](/trade-program): For interior designers and trade buyers.
- [Order Samples](/order-samples): Request physical samples before bulk orders.
- [Find a Designer](/find-designer): Connect with interior designers using our products.
- [Sustainability](/sustainability): Eco-friendly materials and ethical production.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on passementerie, design, and trends.
- [AI Access](/ai-access): Machine-readable catalog and AI assistant access.
- [Support](/support): Help and contact information.

## Collections

- [Tassels](/collections/tassels): Silk, crystal, and metallic decorative tassels.
- [Fringes](/collections/fringes): Bullion, brush, and silk fringe trims.
- [Braids](/collections/braids): Decorative braids and gimp trim.
- [Cords](/collections/cords): Silk cords and rope ties.
- [Tie-backs](/collections/tie-backs): Curtain tiebacks and holders.
- [Embellishments](/collections/embelishments): Beaded accents and metallic trims.
- [Window Treatments](/collections/window-treatments): Custom curtains and drapes.
- [Window Shades](/collections/window-shades): Roman shades with trim finishes.
- [Furniture Trims](/collections/furniture-trims): Sofa fringes and chair borders.
- [Home Accessories](/collections/home-accessories): Pillows and accent pieces.
- [Table Linens](/collections/table-linens): Decorative tablecloths and runners.
- [Outdoor Fabrics](/collections/outdoor-fabrics): Weather-resistant trims and textiles.
